# Tartaria Britannica Magazine

> > Alternative history magazine exploring Tartaria theory, old world technology, aether energy systems, and suppressed architectural mysteries.

Tartaria Britannica Magazine investigates alternative historical narratives centered on the lost civilization of Tartaria, examining evidence of advanced old world technologies including atmospheric energy systems, electromagnetic resonators, and architectural anomalies. The publication challenges mainstream chronology through analysis of historical maps, petrification phenomena, calendar manipulation, and forgotten energy paradigms.

## Key Topics

- Tartaria civilization
- Old world technology
- Aether theory and ionosphere energy
- Alternative history narratives
- Old world architecture
- Electromagnetic and acoustic resonators
- Meltology theory
- Historical cartography
- Free energy systems
- Giants and suppressed archaeology
- Calendar manipulation
- Medieval monuments
- Petrification phenomena
- Star forts
- Atmospheric electricity

## Core Tartaria Theory

- [The Tartaria Genre](https://tartariabritannica.com/the-tartaria-genre): Defines Tartaria as genre exploring hidden history and free energy
- [Maps Showing Tartaria](https://tartariabritannica.com/maps-showing-tartaria): Historical cartography documenting Tartaria's disappearance from maps

## Old World Energy & Technology

- ["AETHER" Part II: Electricity is a Steady Flow of Ions](https://tartariabritannica.com/a-steady-flow-of-ions): Explores aether theory: electricity as ion flow from ionosphere
- [Fireplaces That Do Not Burn Wood](https://tartariabritannica.com/fireplaces-that-do-not-burn-wood): Old world fireplaces using atmospheric etheric energy, not wood
- [The Marvels of Radium by Garrett P. Serviss](https://tartariabritannica.com/the-marvels-of-radium): Historical science: Garrett Serviss on radium and Curie's discoveries

## Catastrophism & Chronology

- [What Melted the World? An Overview of the Meltology Theory](https://tartariabritannica.com/meltology-theory-overview): Meltology theory: evidence of ancient high-heat catastrophic event
- [How Long Does Petrification Take?](https://tartariabritannica.com/how-long-does-petrification-take): Rapid petrification case: German sailor Bajorat in Philippine Sea
- [The New Year Deception: How the Calendar Shifted Over Time](https://tartariabritannica.com/new-year-deception-calendar-shift): Calendar manipulation: from lunar cycles to Gregorian authority
- [The Tally Stick: Forty Thousand Years of Distributed Finance](https://tartariabritannica.com/tally-stick-history): 40,000-year history of tally sticks as blockchain's ancient ancestor

## Architectural Mysteries

- [Mont-Saint-Michel: The Rock That Refused to Be Washed Away](https://tartariabritannica.com/mont-saint-michel-the-rock-that-refused-to-be-washed-away): Medieval marvel Mont-Saint-Michel in Normandy through Tartaria lens
- [Las Lajas Sanctuary - What You Don't Know!](https://tartariabritannica.com/las-lajas-sanctuary): Architectural mystery of Las Lajas Sanctuary in Colombian Andes
- [Star Fort: Bourtange, Holland](https://tartariabritannica.com/star-fort-bourtange-holland): 16th century star fort Bourtange near German-Dutch border

## Ancient Wisdom & Symbolism

- [When the Sun Stands Still: The Winter Solstice](https://tartariabritannica.com/when-the-sun-stands-still-winter-solstice): Winter solstice symbolism in ancient cultures and monuments
- [What Comes Next Begins Here: The Spring Equinox Meaning](https://tartariabritannica.com/what-comes-next-begins-here-the-spring-equinox): Spring equinox as cosmic reset point in natural cycles
- [The Mushroom and the Shaman: Santa's Forgotten Root](https://tartariabritannica.com/mushroom-shaman): Santa origins in Siberian shamanism and Amanita muscaria rituals
- [The Seventh](https://tartariabritannica.com/the-seventh): Irish folklore: supernatural powers of seventh son/daughter healers

## Suppressed History & Folklore

- [Investigating the Tomb of Isoret: Unraveling Giants in St. Germain](https://tartariabritannica.com/the-giant-of-st-germain-folklore-or-hidden-history): Jean Riolan's claims of giant Isoret's tomb in St. Germain examined
- [The Dragon of Crystal Mountain](https://tartariabritannica.com/the-dragon-of-crystal-mountain): Dragon mythology and Crystal Mountain geology in Egypt's White Desert
- [Graf Zeppelin: The Age of Global Airship Travel](https://tartariabritannica.com/graf-zeppelin): LZ-127 Graf Zeppelin's commercial transatlantic and polar flights
